label: Frameworks & Standards
seoTitle: Frameworks and standards for building AI agents
descriptionMd: Frameworks, SDKs, specifications, and interoperability standards used to define, build, or connect agents.
definitionMd: This category covers reusable development abstractions and open standards in which agents, agent runtimes, or agent interactions are the central subject.
scopeMd: Includes implementation frameworks, SDKs, specifications, and interoperability standards that define first-class agent abstractions, runtimes, messages, interfaces, or packaging.
inclusionMd:
- The framework provides first-class agent abstractions, execution, tools, state, or coordination.
- The standard defines interoperable agent behavior, messages, interfaces, or packaging.
- Removing the agent concept would fundamentally change the framework or specification.
exclusionMd:
- It is a general AI, machine-learning, or application framework with no first-class agent model.
- It is an informal convention or thin wrapper without maintained documentation or specification.
selectionGuideMd:
- Is this an implementation framework, an SDK, or an interoperability standard?
- Which agent concepts and extension points are defined?
- What implementations, versioning, and compatibility evidence exist?
useCases: Build agents with reusable tool, state, and execution abstractions
Connect agents and runtimes through interoperable interfaces
Evaluate compatibility across implementations and specification versions

sources.title: Agent2Agent (A2A) Protocol specification
sources.claim: The A2A specification defines an open interaction model through which independent agent systems discover capabilities, exchange information, and manage collaborative tasks.
